nodes.hint: FEM runs are heavy; for regular work connect your own server
nodes.hintTip: Your own server runs your jobs with the same solver version. It connects out over HTTPS, so there are no ports to open, and its CPU time does not count against fair use.

share.label: Share idle time with MOTRES
share.tip: Off by default. When on, MOTRES may run its own jobs on this node while you have nothing queued: only MOTRES catalog work (for example passport computations of catalog motors) that an admin marked shareable, signed and version-pinned like your own jobs. Never the job of another customer, never confidential or NDA data. Shared jobs run at the lowest priority (nice 19, idle IO) within the core and RAM caps below. Your own jobs always go first: a shared job stops within seconds when you submit one, and is re-queued, not failed.
share.capsTip: Default: half of the cores and half of the RAM.
share.stopTip: Turns sharing off and ends the MOTRES job running on this node within seconds; the job is re-queued elsewhere.

rule.fallback: if not converged: retry with damping {damping}, max {max}
rule.steps: scan {n} speeds + both sides of each grid breakpoint → bisect each pass/fail edge to {tol} {unit} → take the upper edge of the highest passing band
rule.lastNot: last run: NOT converged, {n} / {max} iterations used
rule.stopExtra: Between passes the bearing seat must also move less than {bearing} K and the impulse-duty ratio less than {duty} point.

ruleTip.thermal_fixed_point: Each pass takes the current that makes the shaft torque at the magnet temperature, re-checks the voltage, evaluates the losses at the winding temperature and solves the thermal network; the new winding and magnet temperatures go back into the next pass. Damping starts at {start} and is halved (not below {min}) while the residual stalls. If the first run does not settle, one more run starts with damping {fbDamping} and up to {fbMax} iterations; only then is the point called not converged.
ruleTip.speed_search: The speed is the variable: every speed runs the whole chain on the left. The scan covers {scan} speeds plus both sides of every speed where the passport grids change; every pass/fail edge is bisected to {rpmTol} rpm ({passes} refinement passes). The S1 limit is the upper edge of the highest passing band; if the scan ends still passing the limit is only a lower bound.
ruleTip.em_thermal_module: The electromagnetic loss field is solved at a winding temperature; the thermal solve returns a new winding temperature, which is fed back (relaxation {start}) until it moves less than {tol} {unit}, at most {max} passes. Losses go one way, temperatures the other.
ruleTip.em_thermal_orchestrator: The electromagnetic run gives the loss map, the thermal solve gives coil, magnet and bearing temperatures, which become the next run's operating temperatures. Converged when they move less than {tol} {unit} between passes (at most {max} passes). Losses go one way, temperatures the other.
ruleTip.design_search: The optimizer proposes a parameter set, the geometry and mesh are built and the FEM confirms it; the result guides the next proposal. The number of evaluations is set per run.

data.title: Data We Collect
data.body: When you use AeroStator (aerostator.com) or contact us, we collect: (a) account data (name, e-mail address, and authentication records when you sign in with e-mail/password or Google); (b) simulation data, motor configurations, and models you create or save in your workspace; (c) per-user active working time in the app, recorded for the administrator view; (d) signed non-disclosure agreements (NDAs, including company details, signatory name, title, e-mail, IP address, user-agent, timestamp, and text hash) and logs of 3-D model / STEP downloads; (e) your communication preferences and opt-in launch mailing choices; (f) support messages, quote requests, and technical server logs (IP address, browser type, session identifiers).

analytics.title: Analytics and Cookies
analytics.body: We use self-hosted Umami analytics, which is cookieless and collects no personal identifiers. Google Analytics (GA4) runs only after you give cookie consent in the cookie banner, and is never loaded for visitors from China (mainland, Hong Kong, Macau), in Chinese interface mode, or when Do Not Track / Global Privacy Control is enabled. You can change your cookie choice at any time via Cookie settings.

purpose.title: Purpose and Legal Basis
purpose.body: Providing your account, workspace simulations, NDA access, and fulfilling orders: performance of a contract and pre-contractual measures (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR) and legal obligations (Art. 6(1)(c) GDPR). Security, abuse prevention, cookieless Umami statistics, and per-user activity time for the admin view: legitimate interest in operating and securing the platform (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR). Google Analytics cookies, optional dataset sharing, and opt-in launch or topic e-mails managed at /preferences: your explicit consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR), which you may withdraw at any time.

storage.title: Hosting Location and Data Retention
storage.body: Account data, simulation data, and models are stored on our servers in Germany (Hetzner Online GmbH, EU). Workspace and account data are kept while your account is active; you may export your data (ZIP) or request account deletion (with a 7-day cancellation grace period) from the account menu. Enquiry data is retained for up to 3 years after last contact, and invoice/order records for 10 years under Slovenian accounting law. Signed NDA records and model download logs are retained to evidence IP protection and compliance.

sharing.title: Data Sharing
sharing.body: We do not sell or rent your personal data. Data may be processed by: Hetzner Online GmbH (server hosting in Germany, EU); Google LLC (only if you choose Google sign-in or accept Google Analytics cookies outside China); shipping partners (GLS, DHL) for physical motor deliveries; and accounting or legal advisers under confidentiality. Simulation data is included in the anonymised AeroStator community dataset only if you explicitly opt in.

rights.title: Your Rights (GDPR)
rights.body: Under GDPR you have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict, or port your personal data, to object to processing based on legitimate interest, and to withdraw consent at any time (including e-mail preferences at /preferences, dataset sharing, and Cookie settings). You can export your data or request account deletion directly in the app, or write to support@aerostator.com. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Slovenian Information Commissioner (ip-rs.si).

security.title: Security
security.body: We use industry-standard measures to protect your data, including HTTPS encryption, hashed passwords, scoped session tokens, and audited administrator access. No method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure, so we cannot guarantee absolute security.
